verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a public REST API (Embedded Payroll) with concrete endpoints such as GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls. The docs also cover system access tokens, API versioning via header, pagination, idempotency keys, structured errors, webhook subscription endpoints, official client libraries and Postman collections, and an MCP server lets AI tools interact directly with the API. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API, and clarity on access terms, since the API is framed for embedding partners rather than end users.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
